agent_run_lease.rule: run_id and owner_id are non-empty strings, lease_epoch is a positive integer, and timestamps are ISO-8601 values.

rules: Only standalone AgentRuns use agent_run_leases; Goal-backed runs keep using goal_leases.
Acquire, renew, expired takeover, and release are serialized with a durable SQLite transaction.
A first lease starts at lease_epoch 1. Every expired takeover or post-release reacquisition advances a durable per-run epoch high-water mark, so an earlier fencing token is never reused.
Renewal, release, and status mutation require matching owner_id and lease_epoch; stale fencing tokens do not mutate a run.
A status mutation also requires an unexpired current lease within the same transaction.
errors: Empty identifiers, invalid timestamps, and non-positive or boolean lease epochs are rejected.
A missing AgentRun returns status=missing and does not create a lease.
A fresh foreign lease returns status=held_by_other and is not overwritten.

compatibility.additional_output_fields: Consumers ignore fields they do not require.
compatibility.ownership_rule: Goal-backed AgentRuns do not use this contract.
compatibility.fencing_rule: Consumers must carry the returned lease_epoch into every guarded AgentRun mutation.
